title: Collective Emergent Alignment: Measuring and Amplifying Interaction-Induced Reasoning Alignment in Multi-Agent LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.34836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can exhibit emergent behaviors through interaction, yet whether a similar phenomenon exists for reasoning alignment remains largely unexplored. We study whether agent interaction produces additional reference-grounded reasoning alignment beyond matched individual self-refinement, and introduce REMAP (Reference-Entailment-Matrix for Agentic Process), a framework that quantifies this effect through Semantic Coverage and interaction-specific alignment gains. Across diverse model families and two multi-hop reasoning benchmarks, we observe broadly positive interaction gains, particularly on reasoning content that depends on integrating evidence distributed across agents. These gains are consistently associated with independently measured peer-information recovery, while further analysis reveals composition-dependent heterogeneity effects and asymmetric information transfer across agent capability

translated_title: 集体涌现对齐：测量与放大多智能体大语言模型中由交互引发的推理对齐
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统能够通过交互展现出涌现行为，然而推理对齐方面是否存在类似现象在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们研究了智能体交互能否在匹配的个体自我优化之外产生额外的基于参考的推理对齐，并提出了REMAP（智能体过程参考-蕴含矩阵，Reference-Entailment-Matrix for Agentic Process）框架，通过语义覆盖率和交互特有的对齐增益来量化这种效应。在多个模型家族和两个多跳推理基准上，我们观察到普遍积极的交互增益，尤其是在需要整合分布于不同智能体之间证据的推理内容上。这些增益与独立测量的同伴信息恢复能力持续相关，同时进一步分析揭示了依赖于组合方式的异质性效应以及跨智能体能力的不对称信息传递。
tldr: 本文提出REMAP量化框架，首次证实多智能体LLM系统中的交互能够产生超越个体自我优化的涌现式推理对齐增益，且该增益在需要整合分布式证据的推理任务上尤为显著。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces REMAP, a framework that quantifies and confirms emergent reasoning alignment gains induced by interaction in multi-agent LLM systems beyond matched individual self-refinement, with particularly strong gains on reasoning tasks requiring integration of evidence distributed across agents.
